catalog = json.loads((ROOT / 'source/nicegui_base/ai/framework_catalog.json').read_text())
keys = [item['_registry_key'] for item in catalog['registries']['engineering']]
base = 'http://127.0.0.1:18992'
route_rows = []
scenario_rows = {}

    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, executable_path='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome')
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1440, 'height': 900}, device_scale_factor=1)
    def visit(key, viewport, screenshot=None):
        page.set_viewport_size(viewport)

        specimen_count = page.locator('.cui-catalog-specimen').count()
        semantic = {
            'EngineeringEntityCard': '.cui-eng-entity',
            'InvestigationContextBar': '.cui-investigation-context[aria-label=\"Investigation context\"]',
            'EngineeringStatusBadge': '.cui-eng-status',
            'SpecLimitIndicator': '.cui-spec',
            'OutOfSpecIndicator': '.cui-spec',
            'BaselineComparison': '.cui-baseline',
            'ProcessTrendSpec': '.cui-chart-panel, .cui-viz-panel, .cui-echart',
            'DistributionComparisonSpec': '.cui-eng-entity',
            'PopulationComparisonPanel': '.cui-eng-entity',
            'CommonalityTable': '.cui-data-table, .ag-root-wrapper',
            'EvidenceCard': '.cui-evidence',
            'ConfidenceIndicator': '.cui-confidence',
            'RcaEvidencePanel': '.cui-eng-entity',
            'RcaWorkspaceSpec': '.cui-eng-entity',
            'EngineeringTimeline': '.cui-eng-timeline, .cui-timeline',
        }.get(key)
        semantic_count = page.locator(semantic).count() if semantic else 0
        overflow = page.evaluate('({doc: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, body: document.body.scrollWidth, width: innerWidth})')
        row = {
            'key': key, 'route': route, 'status': status, 'specimen_count': specimen_count,
            'semantic_selector': semantic, 'semantic_count': semantic_count,
            'page_errors': list(page_errors), 'console_errors': list(console_errors),
            'failed_requests': list(failed_requests), 'bad_responses': list(bad_responses),
            'horizontal_overflow': overflow['doc'] > overflow['width'] + 1 or overflow['body'] > overflow['width'] + 1,
            'body_excerpt': body[:500],
        }
        if screenshot:
            page.screenshot(path=str(SHOTS / screenshot), full_page=False)
        return row, body

    desktop, desktop_body = visit('InvestigationContextBar', {'width': 1440, 'height': 900}, 'investigation-context-bar-desktop-1440x900.png')
    bar = page.locator('.cui-investigation-context[aria-label=\"Investigation context\"]')
    labels = [value.strip() for value in page.locator('.cui-investigation-context__label').all_text_contents()]
    values = [value.strip() for value in page.locator('.cui-investigation-context__value').all_text_contents()]
    desktop['context_labels'] = labels
    desktop['context_values'] = values
    desktop['has_capability_studio_context'] = 'Capability Studio' in desktop_body
    desktop['synthetic_note_visible'] = 'Synthetic engineering example' in desktop_body
    desktop['context_visible'] = bar.count() == 1 and bar.is_visible()
    scenario_rows['investigation_context_bar_desktop'] = desktop

    mobile, mobile_body = visit('InvestigationContextBar', {'width': 390, 'height': 844}, 'investigation-context-bar-mobile-390x844.png')
    bar = page.locator('.cui-investigation-context[aria-label=\"Investigation context\"]')
    bar_box = bar.bounding_box() if bar.count() else None
    cells = page.locator('.cui-investigation-context__cell')
    cell_evidence = []
    for i in range(cells.count()):
        cell = cells.nth(i)
        value = cell.locator('.cui-investigation-context__value')
        box = cell.bounding_box()
        dims = value.evaluate('(el) => ({clientWidth:el.clientWidth,scrollWidth:el.scrollWidth,clientHeight:el.clientHeight,scrollHeight:el.scrollHeight})')
        cell_evidence.append({'text': cell.inner_text(), 'box': box, 'value_dimensions': dims})
    mobile['bar_box'] = bar_box
    mobile['cells'] = cell_evidence
    mobile['all_critical_labels_visible'] = all(page.get_by_text(label, exact=True).is_visible() for label in ('Investigation', 'Owner', 'Stage', 'Updated'))
    mobile['all_cell_values_visible'] = all(cells.nth(i).locator('.cui-investigation-context__value').is_visible() for i in range(cells.count()))
    mobile['context_visible'] = bar.count() == 1 and bar.is_visible()
    scenario_rows['investigation_context_bar_mobile'] = mobile

    control, control_body = visit('EngineeringEntityCard', {'width': 1440, 'height': 900}, 'engineering-existing-control-desktop-1440x900.png')
    control['entity_card_visible'] = page.locator('.cui-eng-entity').count() > 0 and page.locator('.cui-eng-entity').first.is_visible()
    control['expected_entity_text'] = 'ETCH-021' in control_body and 'Chamber 3' in control_body
    scenario_rows['engineering_existing_control_desktop'] = control

    for key in keys:
        row, body = visit(key, {'width': 1440, 'height': 900})
        row['server_error_text'] = 'Server error' in body or 'KeyError' in body or re.search(r'\\b500\\b', body) is not None
        route_rows.append(row)

    identity = {
        'chrome_version': browser.version,
        'user_agent': page.evaluate('navigator.userAgent'),
        'playwright_version': importlib.metadata.version('playwright'),
        'python_version': platform.python_version(),

        'candidate_head': subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip(),
        'candidate_tree': subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD"'^{tree}'"'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip(),
        'base_url': base,
    }
    browser.close()

result = {

    'route_count': len(route_rows),
    'routes': route_rows,
    'scenarios': scenario_rows,
}
(EVIDENCE / 'browser-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\\n')
print(json.dumps({'identity':identity,'route_results':[{k:r[k] for k in ('key','status','semantic_count','page_errors','console_errors','failed_requests','bad_responses','horizontal_overflow','server_error_text')} for r in route_rows], 'scenarios':scenario_rows, 'evidence_dir':str(EVIDENCE)},indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
PY"
